_comment: AUC Libraries fills this in before a pilot; `agentkit preflight` blocks until approved_by and date are set. Scope lists what the assistant may answer; anything else is handed to a librarian.
scope: Borrowing and renewals (loan periods and limits by patron type)
Main Library hours (live from LibCal; never stored)
Rare Books and Special Collections Library: location, visits, external researchers
RBSCL collection strengths and digital library
Research help: subject librarians and consultations
AUC Knowledge Fountain: theses, dissertations, capstones
Social Research Center Library: hours and use
out_of_scope: Course registration, IT, finance (referred to campus offices)
